title: feat: Phase B (Element Library & Builder) + Phase C (Sharing, Embedding & Permissions)
body:
Implements the next two roadmap phases from the Airtable Interface gap analysis.

### Phase B: Element Library & Builder (v3.3)

- **Interactive elements** — `element:button`, `element:filter`, `element:form`, `element:record_picker` with prop schemas, registered in `PageComponentType` and `ComponentPropsMap`
- **`BlankPageLayoutSchema`** — Grid-based free-form canvas positioning (`columns`, `rowHeight`, `gap`, positioned `items[]`), wired as optional `blankLayout` on `PageSchema`
- **Variable binding** — `PageVariableSchema` gains `record_id` type and `source` field; `ElementRecordPickerPropsSchema` has `targetVariable` for bidirectional binding
- **Studio Interface Builder** — `InterfaceBuilderConfigSchema` with snap/zoom/palette/panel settings (`studio/interface-builder.zod.ts`)

### Phase C: Sharing, Embedding & Permissions (v4.0)

- **`SharingConfigSchema`** — public link, password, domain allowlist, expiration, anonymous access (`ui/sharing.zod.ts`)
- **`EmbedConfigSchema`** — iframe origin restrictions, responsive sizing, header/nav visibility
- **`InterfaceSchema`** — optional `sharing` and `embed` fields (`assignedRoles` already existed)
- **`FormViewSchema`** — optional `sharing` for public form sharing

### Usage

```ts
// Blank page with record picker → variable binding
defineInterface({
  name: 'order_portal',
  label: 'Order Portal',
  sharing: { enabled: true, password: 'secret', expiresAt: '2027-01-01T00:00:00Z' },
  embed: { enabled: true, allowedOrigins: ['https://partner.com'] },
  pages: [{
    name: 'picker_page',
    label: 'Pick Account',
    type: 'blank',
    variables: [
      { name: 'selected_id', type: 'record_id', source: 'acct_picker' },
    ],
    regions: [{
      name: 'main',
      components: [
        { id: 'acct_picker', type: 'element:record_picker',
          properties: { object: 'account', displayField: 'name', targetVariable: 'selected_id' } },
        { id: 'submit', type: 'element:button',
          properties: { label: 'Continue', variant: 'primary' } },
      ],
    }],
    blankLayout: {
      columns: 12,
      items: [
        { componentId: 'acct_picker', x: 0, y: 0, width: 8, height: 2 },
        { componentId: 'submit', x: 0, y: 2, width: 4, height: 1 },
      ],
    },
  }],
});
```

57 new tests, all 5,541 passing. No CodeQL alerts.
